name: Badlands
desc: Eroded buttes standing in five hazed ranks at dusk — one bed stack runs dead level through every rank at the same elevation because they are the same beds, resistant caprock holds the flat tops while the soft beds batter back into talus fans and vertical fluting drains every face; the ranks dolly past at their own rates so new mesas are born at the frame edge for ever, cloud shadows crawl the faces, and a low sun walks the terminator across the whole formation; dusk ochre, sumi ink wash, cut silhouette planes, a cyan survey section, or thermal false-colour.

energy.doc: how hard the low sun bites — modelling on the faces, depth of the cloud shadows, glow on the horizon

scale.doc: how tall the formation stands — at max the near buttes tower off the top of the frame

density.doc: how much blown dust and how many ravens work the thermals

speed.doc: dolly rate past the ranks and how fast the dust drifts (0.15 still creeps)

haze.doc: air stacked between the ranks — aerial perspective and the dust hanging in the troughs

hue.doc: rock hue — the whole bed stack keys off this

x.doc: where the sun sits along the horizon; the terminator follows it

style.doc: aesthetic: dusk, the full ochre-rust-bone-violet bed stack under a low sun / sumi ink wash, the ranks as flat tonal washes and the fluting as dry-brush / cut silhouette planes stacked on a burning sky, no interior detail / a cyan geological section, every bed a schematic band / thermal false-colour, the rock holding the day's heat against a cold sky

seed.doc: geology lottery — bed thicknesses, which beds are resistant caprock, the skyline of every rank
